items.title: Actual Gaussian convolution density and C2 normalized potential

source.anchor: Section3.1 smoothing definition (HTML232-240); Section4.1 setup (HTML403-412), analytic prerequisite to equation4.1/Lemma4.1; PBPS2609.06905v1 Section2.2 actual augmentation marginal
source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu, Matthew S. Zhang; ASTIS explicit smoothing-regularity prerequisite, not full equation4.1 or Lemma4.1.

items.statement: The actual Gaussian add-noise probability law equals volume.withDensity(ofReal(C_eta Z_eta)). Its density is strictly positive at every y, Z_eta is globally C2, and the exact negative-log density U_eta=-log(C_eta Z_eta) is globally C2. The input law may be singular and may lack moments.
assumptions: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space equipped with its Borel measurable space, including dimension zero. eta is a strictly positive real. mu is an arbitrary probability measure on E, possibly singular and without finite moments.

C_eta=((sqrt(2*pi*eta))^-1)^dim E and Z_eta(y)=integral exp(-norm(y-x)^2/(2*eta)) dmu(x). The actual smoothed law is the measurable pushforward of mu×standard Gaussian by (x,g)->x+sqrt(eta)g. The potential is exactly -log(C_eta Z_eta), not Gaussian averaging of an input potential.

All first/second Gaussian derivative domination, Bochner integrability, measurability and strictly positive normalizers are derived. The local CLM dual instances choose existing canonical normed structures and add no mathematical premises. No input density, moment, curvature or supplied regularity certificate is assumed.

Source Section3.1 defines the unnormalized convolution exp(-V_eta)=exp(-V)*Gaussian. This theorem constructs the exact normalized density potential U_eta=-log(C_eta Z_mu). For Gibbs mu=exp(-V) volume/Z_V, U_eta=V_eta+log Z_V; formalizing that Gibbs specialization and constant-shift adapter remains separate. This normalization difference does not change derivatives, but the two chosen potentials are not asserted literally identical.

formulae.label: Actual smoothing and negative-log density
formulae.tex: \pi_\eta=(x+\sqrt\eta\,g)_\#(\mu\otimes\gamma)=C_\eta Z_\eta\,dx,\quad Z_\eta(y)=\int e^{-\|y-x\|^2/(2\eta)}\mu(dx)>0,\quad Z_\eta,U_\eta=-\log(C_\eta Z_\eta)\in C^2.
